pages.text: $(bold)Yellow King Remnant$()$(br2)Obtaining: fall freely from $(bold)Y > 400$() all the way down to $(bold)Y < -50$(), surviving the $(bold)20-second$() ordeal (taking 3 magic damage every 3 seconds), and a $(bold)50%$() chance to receive $(bold)16$() of this item — otherwise, you suffer $(bold)Wither for 60 seconds$().$(br2)Usage: smelt → $(bold)10 mB$() of Molten Hastur Malice, the source of the $(l:materials/material_hastur_malice)Hastur Malice$() material.
